entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpillar, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

divine_benefits: The Lord shall restore your wasted years beyond your expectations
The Lord shall give you double of all that your enemies thought he had destroyed.
Your later days shall be better than your beginning.
entries.condition: Put away sins of any kind deliberately before it will overthrow your destiny and your life of commitment to his instructions and you will be brought back to your original place of comfort that God has arranged for you.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to put away every manner of sin. I don't want to lose out on your plans from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: All your wasted efforts shall be restored in a moment to the surprise of men, and great increase shall answer to every effort you shall begin to make from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 1 CORINTHIANS 15 EVENING: 2 CHRONICLES 10-12

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you, and my people shall never be ashamed.

divine_benefits: You shall begin to eat in plenty and have enough to give out.
The Lord shall give you satisfaction in life
You shall be a bundle of miracles to your world.
Every form of shame and disgrace has been terminated by the Lord.
entries.condition: Turn over your life to God to manage. He knows the best and has the best for you. Own nothing to yourself, allow God to take full control of everything that concerns you, and you will not know regret in life.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me the best way to hand over my life and everything that concerns for you to manage. I don't want to regret in the journey of life from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your life shall begin to magnet divine abundance without end from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 1 CORINTHIANS 16 EVENING: 2 CHRONICLES 13-15

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and none else, and my people shall never be ashamed.

divine_benefits: The Lord God is with you; you cannot fall.
The Lord will manifest Himself through your life to your world.
No more oppression and no more disgrace for you.
entries.condition: Sin is a spiritual killer disease; it kills faster than AIDS. Run away from it before it kills your destiny and, in the end, sends you to hell. Choose to embrace Jesus and His way and live your life to please Him, and He will abide with you and show you the way to fulfillment in life.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to run away from sin of all kinds. I don't want to be destroyed. Teach me to please you from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: God's presence in your life shall differentiate you wherever you are and will make you stand out in all you do from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 CORINTHIANS 1-2 EVENING: 2 CHRONICLES 16-18

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: For l am the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

divine_benefits: God cannot change; His promises concerning you are sure.
You cannot be destroyed by your enemies
God's mercies surround you daily.
entries.condition: Learn to submit your heart and obey divine instructions completely; you cannot compromise His Word if you want to enjoy His benefits to the fullest. Decide to respond to Him with complete obedience and with a delightful heart.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to submit my heart and obey divine instruction completely without any compromise and with a delightful heart from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: You can never be consumed by the plans of the enemies. The Lord has given you victory over them. No more failure and untimely death from this day in Jesus' name
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 CORINTHIANS 3-4 EVENING: 2 CHRONICLES 19-20

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them, return unto me, and / will return unto you, saith the LORD of hosts. But ye said, wherein shall we return?

divine_benefits: The mercy of God will always speak on your behalf
God's hands are wide open to receive you back as His own child
God's love surrounds you.
entries.condition: Return to God with all your heart and be flexible to Him. Don't ignore or disobey His instructions, because your life of progress and fulfillment is tied to it. If you don't want to suffer satanic oppression and disappointments, choose to place importance on God's instructions by doing them with all your heart.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to return to you with all my heart, never to ignore or disobey your word anymore, teach me to be flexible to you no matter the cost from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: God has decided to bless you; no man can curse you, the yoke of satan is broken over you, go ahead and enjoy God's abundance from this day in Jesus' name
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 CORINTHIANS 5 EVENING: 2 KINGS 1-3

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.

divine_benefits: God's love is speaking on your behalf.
God has arranged open heaven to pour down His blessings on you.
entries.condition: Until God's words make meaning to you, you cannot live a meaningful life. The closer you are to Him, the better life becomes. Make up your mind to give Him what belongs to Him completely with delight, and you will experience the outpouring of His blessings.
entries.prayer: Lord, I want to live a meaningful life. Let your word make meaning in my heart so that I can obey it completely with great delight from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: Every curse over your life is broken by God. Receive grace to live to the standard of God's word, for you to enjoy the outpouring of His blessings without end from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 CORINTHIANS 6 EVENING: 2 KINGS 4-5

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

divine_benefits: God's treasure house is open for you.
God will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessings upon blessings
entries.condition: God knows what He has committed into your hands. You cannot rob God and survive financially. You must obey God's instructions for it to be well with you. If you don't give Him His first and rightful position in your finances with your complete tithes and good offerings, you are only cooperating with the devil to make things tight for you. God is not hungry. Do your part, and God's part will not fail.
entries.prayer: Lord, I received grace to give you your rightful position in my finances, for you are the owner of my life and everything that concerns me from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: Lack and scarcity shall be far from your dwelling; you shall be known for honour and abundance from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 CORINTHIANS 7 EVENING: 2 KINGS 6-7

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: And I will rebuke devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, said the LORD of hosts.

divine_benefits: You shall greatly increase by the decree of the Lord. 2.The Lord will protect you from every destruction and plague.
No more miscarriage or disappointment of any kind in your life.
entries.condition: You cannot avoid complete tithing to God if you want to live above the devourer in life. TITHE is a responsibility you must be delighted to carry out because the life of a constant flow of God's blessings is tied to it. Avoiding tithing and giving of good offerings is just avoiding prosperity in life. Obey God in totality, and the law of nature will release your treasures.
entries.prayer: Lord, take away every greediness from me so that I can truly obey your word in finance from this day, in Jesus' name
entries.prophetic_words: It is your turn to be in charge. The Lord is commanding unusual blessings on you from every side from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 CORINTHIANS 8 EVENING: 2 KINGS 8-9

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.

divine_benefits: All your destroyers shall be totally destroyed by God.
All your enemies shall be enslaved
Those that rob you shall be robbed
The Lord shall attack all your attackers
entries.condition: Give up the life of sin and be addicted to God in love. The root cause of frustration, sorrow, pains etc is sin. You cannot be comfortable until you give up the life style of sin, embrace God's way and enjoy the life of comfort and joy.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to give up the lifestyle of sin no matter the cost and teach me to walk in your ways from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: No more devourer, no more pains. As you respond to God's way of life comfort and success shall begin to respond to you from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 CORINTHIANS 11 EVENING: 2 CHRONICLES 21-24

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: And all nations shall call you blessed; for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.

divine_benefits: The Lord will make you the next good news to your generation.
You shall be wonderfully blessed and favoured by God.
entries.condition: Take up the responsibility of paying tithes and good offerings, it is a divine instruction; it is a kingdom responsibility if you truly belong to His kingdom. It is a responsibility you cannot avoid or play with if you must be a wonder to your world. God is faithful to do His path, if you can respond whole heartedly, correctly, faithfully and joyfully.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to die to self so that! can truly accept and perform my kingdom responsibilities, for me to enjoy the complete blessings in it from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: As you accept kingdom duties, you are set to enjoy the best that the kingdom offers. You will handle the best in life and people shall honour you on earth from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 CORINTHIANS 9-10 EVENING: 2 KINGS 10-12

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: For l will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD, because they called thee an outcast, saying, this is Zion whom no man seeketh after.

divine_benefits: The Lord is restoring your complete health on every side of life.
God is healing every wound around your life.
Those who rejected you shall begin to embrace you.
entries.condition: Don't play with anything call SIN, that is the major cankerworm that eats up the crown of destiny and crowns your effort with failure. If you don't want to experience cankerworm on the path to destiny, depend on God's grace and make up your mind to do away with sin and adjust to God's way of life.
entries.prayer: LORD, help me to do away with anything called sin. I don't want to fail from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: You are divinely healed of every manner of sickness. You shall be known as an achiever from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 CORINTHIANS 12-13 EVENING: JOEL 1-3

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents and have mercy on his dwelling places; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.

divine_benefits: The Lord will restore you to your original position in life.
The Lord will rebuild every broken wall around your life.
The Lord will restore your lost glory and honour.
entries.condition: It is righteous living that attract God into the life of anybody; If you can truly choose that way, honour and dignity shall be your clothing
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to live a righteous life before you from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: You are restored by God. He will rebuild you and reconstruct your palace and take you to your destined throne from this day in Jesus' name,
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 1 EVENING: JONAH 1-4

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry; and /will multiply them; and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be. small

divine_benefits: Your life and generation will be filled with joy for God's wonders.
Thanksgiving shall proceed out of your dwelling.
The Lord will multiply you, make you great and highly honoured everywhere.
entries.condition: Learn to live an appreciative life towards God by being committed to His ways and services. Don't be distracted by anything; make Him your major focus, and He will make you stand out in life.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to be appreciative of you by being committed to your ways and your services without permitting any distraction from this day, in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your life shall begin to bring praise to God; No more reproach and insult. God has decided to crown you with glory; the earth has no choice, they must honour you from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 2 EVENING: 2 KINGS 13-14

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me; and I will punish all that oppress them.

divine_benefits: Your generation shall prosper for your sake.
The Lord shall establish your destiny to His glory.
The Lord will punish anyone who tries to hurt you because you belong to Him
entries.condition: Make God and His word your greatest delight and manifest it through your lifestyle; let your world know that you truly belong to Him, and He will be delighted to make you great.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to make you my greatest delight to the level that it will be seen in my lifestyle from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: God is standing in your defence, and He will make you a pride to His great name in your generation, in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 3 EVENING: 2 KINGS 15-16

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their. governor shall proceed from the midst of them, and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me, for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? Saith the LORD.

divine_benefits: An important personality shall emerge in you.
Governors and great people shall proceed from you
You are now God's delighted child.
entries.condition: Let there be a determination in your heart to know God the more and be closer to Him, than the closer you are to Him, the brighter the future becomes.
entries.prayer: Lord, create in me a strong determination to know you and be closer to you than ever from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: As you determine to know God, you shall be known for honour and dignity throughout your generation from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 4-5 EVENING: 2 KINGS 17-18

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: And ye shall be my people, and / will be your God.

divine_benefits: You are God's property
The mark of God's ownership is on you
No enemy can tamper with you.
entries.condition: If you truly belong to God's family, take time to know His instruction and decide to abide by them with great joy and teach others with your lifestyle how to please God genuinely, then God will be glad to associate Himself with you.
entries.prayer: Lord, I belong to you; help me to abide by your instructions and live to please you genuinely from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: You belong to the unlimited God, you cannot be limited in life, your life shall be an announcement of His greatness on earth from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 6-7 EVENING: 2 KINGS 19-20

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love therefore with loving kindness have I drawn thee.

divine_benefits: The Lord has loved you with everlasting love.
With loving-kindness, God has drawn you close to Himself.
entries.condition: God has been very patient with you over. that weak point of yours. Make up your mind to do away with it before it will tamper with your destiny. God loves you so much, but don't take His love and patience for granted; whatever you take for granted will grind you.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to do away with every weak point in my life, I don't want to take your love and patient for granted from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: As you appreciate God's love for your life, the work of your hands shall be appreciated by men from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 8 EVENING: 2 CHRONICLES 25-27

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Again I will build thee, and thou shall be built, o virgin of Israel; thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the danced of them that make merry.

divine_benefits: You are precious to the Lord
The Lord shall rebuild you and your generation
Once again you will dance for joy..
The Lord will make you a celebrity
entries.condition: Every area you know in your life that is bringing reproach to the name of the Lord, take time to work on yourself through the spirit of His word, depend on the Holy Spirit for spiritual growth, and God will take pleasure in blessing you and make you a blessing.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to work on any area in my life that does not bring glory to you through your spirit from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: It is your turn to dance and celebrate, for God has risen to beautify you on every side of life from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 9 EVENING: 2 CHRONICLES 28-29

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria; the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.

divine_benefits: You will eat the fruits of your labour.
Your enemies shall no more destroy the labour of your hands.
God's blessings in your life shall be as a common things..
entries.condition: Labour with your hands, no lazy man can be blessed. It is the work of your hands that God will work through to bless you. As you work hard, depend on Him totally. Obey His word and you will notice that He is the lifter of your head.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to labour with my hands trusting you to lift me in due season from this day, in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: The Lord has decided to raise you, no power can pull you down. He has decided to bless you; no one can curse you from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 10 EVENING: 2 CHRONICLES 30-32

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: For there shall be a day, that the watchman upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.

divine_benefits: The Lord will design you with His glory and your life shall be so attractive.
Many will run to you for help
Many will choose to serve your God.
entries.condition: Honour God with your life and everything that concerns you, let your desire to know Him get stronger. Create time to study His word prayerfully for a closer relationship, and you will find out yourself that there is fulfillment in Him.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to honour you with all that lam and with all that I have, with a strong desire to know you the more from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: The Lord is raising you above those who thought they were better, and you shall keep going up beyond human expression to the glory of His name from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 11 EVENING: ISAIAH 1-4

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: For thus saith the LORD; sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations; publish ye, praise ye, and say 0 LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.

divine_benefits: Celebrate and sing with great joy. 2.The Lord will raise you as the greatest among your equals.
God shall give you many reasons to shout out in praise to God with a joyful heart.
The Lord has come to your rescue.
entries.condition: Live a different life from the people of the world, allow God's word to take control of you to the level it will be seen in your actions and in your words, let your world know that you belong to Him, and He will be glad to bring you to the land of fulfillment.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to live a different life from the people of the world, let your word be my controller from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Victory is your crown, favor and honour are now your bodyguard, the Lord is your strength from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 12-13 EVENING: ISAIAH 5-7

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child, and her that travaileth with child together a great company shall return thither.

divine_benefits: You are coming out of the land of bondage into the land of fulfilment
The Lord will gather your treasures from every corner of the earth.
You shall recover all that the enemies have taken from you.
entries.condition: Repent genuinely from every evil and take a solid decision never to go back to them, break up every friendship that leads to a sinful life, style, and be close to people that will help you know God the more, and your life shall be a light that lightens others.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to put away every evil from my life and teach me to know you more from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: You are now a centre of attraction where your life shall begin to magnet the best in life from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 14 EVENING: ISAIAH 8-10

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: They shall come with weeping and with supplications will | lead them; / will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble; for l am a father to Israel and Ephraim is my first born.

divine_benefits: The Lord will lead you into your destiny with great care.
God will make you walk beside the quiet stream and you will not stumble.
God is your father and you are His favourite.
entries.condition: Put on the attitude of a true child of God that will poińt your generation to serve Him genuinely. If God is your father then live like Him and represent Him well in this world of sin and He will always stand in your defence.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to put on the attitude of your true child that will point my generation to serve you from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: It is your season of restoration, your joy shall no longer know boundaries; others shall see and dance with you in Jesus' Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: Jesus name. DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: ROMANS 15-16 EVENING: ISAIAH 11-14

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.

divine_benefits: The news of your restoration shall spread abroad.
The Lord shall gather all your scattered treasures back to you.
The Lord will protect you like a shepherd guarding his flock
entries.condition: God is too righteous to behold sin, if you must enjoy His favour, you have to live a righteous life, pull off the coat of sin before it scatters your destiny. Sin is a scatterer of destiny; don't permit it in your life at all. You are precious to God, and He wants to make something great out of you.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to live a righteous life before you. I don't want my destiny to be scattered from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: The law of life and nature can no longer hold back your God's given treasures, you case is different from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: EPHESIANS 1 EVENING: ISAIAH 15-19

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd; and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

divine_benefits: God is giving you all that you need to be successful in the journey of life.
The Lord will make you prosperous and grow like a watered garden.
entries.condition: Make God the source of your success and depend on Him for direction. Be ready to obey every instructions that comes from Him and your life will not know failure.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to depend on you as the source of my success to the level that I will take instructions from you from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your mourning days are over, you are divinely ushered into your days of celebration from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: EPHESIANS 4 EVENING: ISAIAH 24-27

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.

divine_benefits: The Lord has rescued you from all your enemies.
The Lord will stand in your defence any time, any day.
entries.condition: Put your trust in the Lord in all you do. It is your trust in Him that magnet Him into any situation that comes your way. He will never let down those who truly depend on Him. Don't allow your situation to control you, and He will be glad to appear when you need Him.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to truly depend on you to the level I will remove my eyes from the situation and fix it on you from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: You have been rescued from sin, sickness, sorrow, poverty, and eternal death by the Lord. Receive grace to enjoy your freedom in Him from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: EPHESIANS 2-3 EVENING: ISAIAH 20-23

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

divine_benefits: From this day, the Lord will cause you and all that concerns you to celebrate and dance for joy..
The Lord has appeared for your comfort.
The Lord is turning your sorrow into joy.
All your captivity with its sorrows shall be forgotten.
entries.condition: Learn to return all glory to God for the abundance of all things and even the ones He promises to do, and you will keep going up; nobody can stop your progress. The more you thank God, the sweeter He makes life become. Learn to thank God.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to return all the glory to you who has giving me the abundance of all things to enjoy from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: You will dance with meaning that they that see you will dance with you from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: EPHESIANS 5 EVENING: ISAIAH 28-29

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.

divine_benefits: The Lord will bless you above your expectations.
You shall be satisfied with the goodness of the Lord.
entries.condition: Thanksgiving to the Lord is the short cut to the next level of life, learn to do it with all your heart, release your best for Him, and He will be glad to make you the best in life. Don't treat Him as a beggar in the name of Thanksgiving. Don't even thank Him as if He is a burden. If you don't want your burden to multiply, whatever you are, He made you, so approach Him with great delight and with your best, and you shall be qualified for His best.
entries.prayer: Lord, you have done me well, teach me to approach you with a grateful heart of joy with my best from this day in Jesus' name.
entries.prophetic_words: The quality of your thanksgiving to the Lord will take you above your equals in life from this day, in Jesus' name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: EPHESIANS 6 EVENING: ISAIAH 30-32

entries.theme: TOTAL RECOVERY IS YOUR PORTION

memory_verse.text: Thus saith the LORD, Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD, and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

entries.condition: Obey God with gladness and approach Him with a joyful heart of appreciation, for His wonders in your life, there is nothing you will do for Him that can be compared to His wonders in your life, just render your best service to Him and He will be glad to do more.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to obey you gladly with my heart full of appreciation for what you have done for me from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your life is becoming announcer of God's greatness to your world. Receive grace to remain grateful unto Him from this day in Jesus name

entries.theme: IT IS YOUR TURN TO TESTIFY

memory_verse.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise; be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

divine_benefits: The Lord has been so good to you and He will continue His faithfulness in your life.
God created you for Himself, so, you have nothing to lack, He is your providence.
entries.condition: Deliberately enter into God's house with great thanksgiving with your heart full of praises to Him. You cannot really pay for what He has done but He want you to show your deep appreciation.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to sincerely show how grateful I am for all you have done in my life from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your thanksgiving to the Lord will take you to another realm of His blessings from you from this day in Jesus name.

entries.theme: IT IS YOUR TURN TO TESTIFY

memory_verse.text: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

divine_benefits: The Lord is always good to you and He will continue to be good.
God is always loving and kind and He will keep doing it because that is His nature.
God's faithfulness in your life will continue to the next generation and forever.
entries.condition: Approach God with meaningful worship, praise and thanksgiving, such service requires preparation, having considered what He has done. It is your meaningful appreciation with your heart of joy that compel heaven to make your life meaningful on earth.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to approach you with meaningful appreciation with a joyful heart from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: God has done it for you. He has placed a crown of honour on your head, health, wealth and long life will notice and make friend with you from this day in Jesus name.
